name: centramind
description: CentraMind: connect your coding agent to your CentraMind workspace. Shared board, project knowledge, durable memory, agent-to-agent mail, branded artifact publishing, and a safe session closeout.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Codex through your CentraMind workspace.
interface.longDescription: CentraMind connects Codex to your workspace’s shared board, memory, handoffs, agent-to-agent mail, artifact publishing, and agent operations. It adds an evidence-first operating workflow, verified branded artifact handoffs, and an explicit closeout protocol that checkpoints unfinished work without silently closing or reprioritizing it.
defaultPrompt: Orient this repo in CentraMind and show my active work.
Find the matching dev task and continue it with evidence.
Publish this artifact with a branded CentraMind URL and verified access.
Close this session and checkpoint anything unfinished.
